We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (from make_6_lvl2-template_search-2) to the molecule given in make_6_lvl2-apply_template-1. The input from apply_template-1 is a list of SMILES: [['COc1ccc(CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3cccc(OC)c3)nnn2Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)cc1']]. So target molecule SMILES is "COc1ccc(CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3cccc(OC)c3)nnn2Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)cc1". The template_id from template_search-2 is 953818. We need to apply that template to the target molecule and return all possible precursor combinations (list of lists of SMILES). Use apply_template tool.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles and template_id.
